title: Didn’t open the can till I used a third can! Smooth lid,hard to turn .
text:
Didn’t open the can till I used a third can! Smooth lid,hard to turn .. I been using using for over 20years , the almost same type of can opener and thought it was time for a new one.
First time I used this can opener it went around the can So easy! Because it didn’t open the can!
I used it the second time, and it only opened half the can!
Guess 3 times is the charm, it did opened the whole can, but I did not feel it was easy turning the knob.
And this opener does not have anything to get the lid up, have to pull it off hard

My other one has a thingie that lifts the lid off easy, and has a hook to take tabs off of other types of cans etc.
That said my old one that Amazon still sells is more expensive. This can opener is less money , and finally works.
Once the can is opened , it is smooth and cannot cut anyone .
This comes with a separate bottle opener.
